reason: Owner decision 2026-10-13: non-sovereign territories and disputed places are in scope, game venue map only, no claims about real borders, operations or sovereignty. Taiwan relation 449220 (v202, admin_level=2, ISO3166-1=TW) lists 27 member ways. Three of them are two whole separate maritime rings far from the island that the Geofabrik taiwan clip does not contain: the closed Pratas/Dongsha ring (way 284788564, nodes near 20.94N 116.65E) and the Taiping Island ring (way 654482085, a boundary=maritime restricted-waters line, plus way 1199677144, the maritime=yes line between the same two end nodes, near 10.33N 114.34E). Neither ring touches a node of any other member way, and the 24 present ways close into rings on their own (checked against the OSM API geometry and the published taiwan.poly).
note: PREDICTED, not read from the PBF: absence is derived from the published europe taiwan.poly (no node of these three ways lies inside it; the same rule matched every observed hold). The 24 present ways have no loose endpoint. If the hosted run reports a different missingMemberWayIds set the boundary stage HOLDs and names the exact set. Replaces the china and philippines neighbour merge (1.6 GB and 610 MB) of the earlier draft.
